How do SCRIPE-Frontend and SCRIPE-Backend unite into a zero-trust operating system?

Long image

A

Answer

SCRIPE v6.0 pairs a 5-layer MVVM Next.js 16 portal with an 18-module .NET 10 modular monolith governed by scripe-cli.1

  1. Frontend features live in isolated sub-modules following View -> ViewModel -> Repository -> Service -> IApiService with co-located EN/AR locales.2
  2. Every API request clears a 29-stage security pipeline and a 6-behavior AstraFlow mediator before returning Result<T>.3
  3. BaseDbContext atomically commits tenant-filtered rows, idempotency_receipts, and outbox_messages across PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and Oracle.4
  4. scripe-cli enforces boundary checks (scripe arch-check), locale parity (scripe validate-locales), and 11-point UAT readiness.5

Applies toNext.js 16 + React 19.NET 10 + AstraFlow 2.3.018 Backend Modules65+ Frontend Sub-Modules193 CLI Commands

1

How does a user action travel from a React 19 View to Dual-Mode persistence?

Diagram structure
  • Edge Proxy & RouteGuard edge_guard
  • Views & @core/ui/* mvvm_ui
  • ViewModel & Repository mvvm_data
  • ApiService Gateway api_service
  • scripe-cli Toolchain scripe_cli
  • 29-Stage Security Gate http_security
  • AstraFlow 2.3.0 Mediator astraflow_bus
  • Redis L1 & Locks redis_cluster
  • 18 Domain Modules domain_modules
  • BaseDbContext & Schemas base_db
  • Outbox & SignalR Hub outbox_signalr
  • edge_guard → mvvm_ui · authorized route
  • mvvm_ui → mvvm_data · UI action
  • mvvm_data → api_service · repo -> service
  • api_service → http_security · HTTPS + JWT + Key
  • http_security → astraflow_bus · ISender.Send
  • astraflow_bus → redis_cluster · L1 receipt & cache
  • astraflow_bus → domain_modules · dispatch handler
  • domain_modules → base_db · atomic SaveChanges
  • base_db → outbox_signalr · poll outbox_messages
  • outbox_signalr → mvvm_ui · SignalR push
  • scripe_cli → mvvm_ui · validate-locales
  • scripe_cli → domain_modules · arch-check & seed
  1. Edge & RouteGuard ↗

    Next.js proxy.ts checks auth cookies at the edge; RouteGuard verifies PAGE_PERMISSIONS and Edition entitlements.

  2. 5-Layer MVVM UI & Data ↗

    Views compose @core/ui primitives and bind to ViewModels (useCrudViewModel) that call Repositories and Services.

  3. Single-Flight ApiService ↗

    Injects Bearer JWT, X-Tenant-Id, and X-Idempotency-Key, queuing concurrent 401 responses behind a single refresh mutex.

  4. 29-Stage Security Gate ↗

    Enforces rate limits, Redis JWT revocation checks, CSRF tokens, replay nonces, and PBAC authorization.

  5. AstraFlow 2.3.0 Pipeline ↗

    Dispatches ICommand<T> through Logging, Validation, 3-TX Idempotency, Caching, and compile-time [AstraGenerateMapping].

  6. BaseDbContext & Outbox ↗

    Commits schema-isolated rows and outbox_messages in one ACID transaction; OutboxProcessor broadcasts SignalR updates.

How do the 5 frontend MVVM layers and 3 backend transactions coordinate a mutation?

Diagram structure
  • BookingWorkspaceView view
  • ViewModel + Repo vm
  • ApiService (401 Mutex) api
  • 29-Stage Pipeline mw
  • AstraFlow + 3-TX Idem af
  • BaseDbContext + Outbox db
  • view → vm · confirmReservation(slotId, quoteId)
  • vm → api · BookingRepository.create() -> Service.post()
  • api → mw · POST /api/v1/venue/reservations (X-Idempotency-Key)
  • mw → af · PBAC + Replay Verified -> ISender.Send(Command)
  • af → db · TX 1: INSERT Reserved Receipt (2m Lease)
  • db → af · Claim Committed
  • af → db · TX 2: Save Reservation + AuditLog + outbox_messages
  • af → db · TX 3: UPDATE Receipt Completed (AES-GCM Envelope)
  • af → api · 200 OK Result<ReservationResponse>
  • api → vm · Unwrap Result<T> -> Map Domain Entity
  • vm → view · Invalidate TanStack Query + Semantic Toast
  • db → view · OutboxProcessor -> SignalR Live Calendar Sync

Why pair client X-Idempotency-Key headers with backend 3-TX receipts?

When ApiService replays a mutating call after a single-flight 401 refresh, it reuses the same X-Idempotency-Key. IdempotencyBehavior returns the sealed Result<T> receipt instead of double-booking.3
